sub_items.description: Sky News live broadcast (Sept 11, 2025, ~5:27 PM Phoenix time) reporting Air Force 2 landing at Sky Harbor Airport with Kirk's body and motorcade en route to Hansen Mortuary

Andrew Kolvet pre-recorded interview on Alex Clark Show denying Charlie was becoming Catholic; describes Erika as cradle Catholic who followed a non-denominational path; references Erika's own prior denial of conversion on social media

Defense memorandum excerpt describing Kirk's autopsy: left neck strap muscles, left common carotid, and left internal/external jugular veins perforated; C7 vertebra obliterated; cervical spinal cord transected; hemorrhaging around heart and both lungs
X account "Lisa Knows" tweet accusing Candace of releasing footage the judge ordered not to be shown to the public; asserts Candace "docketed a witness"; calls for obstruction charges
Viewer email crediting Candace's Becoming Brigitte series with helping save their marriage from husband's emotional affair and reconnecting viewer with their sister
Andrew Kolvet tweet(s) posted 8:49 PM (2026-07-29) containing a list of words Candace has mispronounced across 367+ hours of podcasting
Tim Pool tweet responding to Alex Jones stating that the Losee rooftop footage "serves as a counter to the exploding Mike claims"

Blake Neff post responding to Alex Jones asserting that there exists another rooftop video from a different angle capturing the moment the rifle is pulled from the shooter's pants; notes defense demanded the footage be kept from the public on prejudice grounds

artifacts.bundle_name: Beavis and Butt-Head Podcast Clip Bundle

sub_items.description: Podcast audio clip (host labels "Beavis and Butt-Head show") in which a participant identified as Andrew describes another rooftop video angle: shooter rolls over railing, appears to assemble/pull a weapon from his pants, brief blind spot, then the visible Lozi footage shows running and prone position

Media Siege host known as "Paramount Not So Tactical" tweet sharing a photo of a baby crawling, presented as proof that the rooftop figure's behavior was untrained human reflex rather than tactical training

Community Note applied to obstruction-accusation tweets clarifying that court broadcasting limits apply to courtroom media (not third-party commentators) and that legal obstruction of justice requires corrupt intent to impede proceedings
X user tweet demanding Candace be charged with obstruction of justice / jury tampering for releasing the rooftop footage; asserts a "judge [graft?] demanded [it] not be shown"

artifacts.bundle_name: Erika Kirk Tyler Robinson Interview Clip Bundle

sub_items.description: Short clip of Erika Kirk being asked whether she believes Tyler Robinson murdered her husband and answering yes, played at the top of the episode
Host verbal reference to the exclusive Losee Center rooftop video released the previous day (not replayed in this episode)
Host verbal reference to footage of Erika leaning over Charlie Kirk's open casket in Utah, later posted by Erika to social media (not replayed)
Host verbal reference to text messages she says she read, sent by people with knowledge of the Hansen mock burial refusal (not shown)
Clip from the preliminary hearing in which the prosecution asserts the defendant used a screwdriver, citing exhibits 12.1 and 12.4 (host asks producer Skyhorse for the clip; shown or played)
Viewer comment from Amaruso (Ama Amar Musa) read aloud arguing conservation of momentum shows Charlie would have snapped backward if his neck stopped the bullet

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk
nodes.description: Primary subject of episode's evidentiary claims: defense-memorandum autopsy findings, funeral/burial arrangements, Sky News arrival report.

nodes.description: Persistent investigation target: whether Charlie Kirk was actually interred at a Catholic cemetery, or subject to a mock burial before/after cremation.

nodes.name: Mock Burial Allegation

nodes.name: Kirk Autopsy Heart/Lung Hemorrhage Causation

nodes.description: Investigation target concerning Hansen Mortuary's involvement: receipt of Kirk's body on Sept 11, alleged refusal to participate in mock burial, and transition of remains to a Catholic funeral.

nodes.name: Kirk Religious Affiliation Status

nodes.name: Rooftop Screwdriver Claim
nodes.description: The dispute over whether a screwdriver was recovered from or used on the Losee rooftop: Neff and the prosecution (exhibits 12.1 and 12.4) are cited as asserting it, and the host says no evidence of a screwdriver has been shown.

claims.label: Prosecution Memo: Bullet Perforated Left Neck Structures and C7 Vertebra
claims.claim: Per the prosecution's memorandum the host reads, the bullet, or at least parts of it, sequentially perforated the anterior left side of Kirk's neck strap muscles, left common carotid artery, and left internal and external jugular veins, obliterated the left side of the C7 vertebra, and transected the cervical spinal cord.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the complete defense memorandum and compare with the medical examiner's full autopsy report and any independent forensic review.

claims.label: Prosecution Memo: Hemorrhaging Around Heart and Both Lungs Observed
claims.claim: Per the prosecution's memorandum the host reads, the medical examiner observed hemorrhaging around Kirk's heart and both of his lungs (left and right).
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain complete autopsy findings; consult independent medical expert on whether hemorrhaging is consistent with the described bullet trajectory, post-injury resuscitation, or alternative blunt force trauma.

claims.label: Blake Neff Asserts Existence of Another Rooftop Angle
claims.claim: Blake Neff posted that there exists another rooftop video from a different angle that captures the moment the rifle is pulled from the shooter's pants, noting this moment is not visible in the Losee rooftop video.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the claim via courtroom exhibit records; determine whether any second rooftop footage was formally entered as evidence in the preliminary hearing.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Responds With Pronunciation List Tweet
claims.claim: At 8:49 PM on 2026-07-29, the evening after Candace's previous episode, Andrew Kolvet posted tweets containing a list of words Candace has mispronounced across 367+ hours of podcasting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original tweet thread; verify timing relative to the rooftop footage release.

claims.label: Sky News Reports Kirk's Body En Route to Hansen Mortuary
claims.claim: In a Sky News clip the host plays, a reporter says that on 2025-09-11 at 5:27 PM Phoenix time Air Force 2 had landed about an hour earlier at Sky Harbor Airport carrying Kirk's body and that the motorcade was heading to Hansen Mortuary in Phoenix.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Sky News broadcast archive; confirm mortuary receipt and timing against Hansen Mortuary records.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet States Charlie Was Not Becoming Catholic
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays from Alex Clark's show, Andrew Kolvet says Charlie was not becoming Catholic and describes Erika as a cradle Catholic who, like him, followed a non-denominational path; another speaker in the clip adds that Erika once answered a comment asking if they were converting with "No, we just like attending sometimes."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Alex Clark interview recording; verify pre-record date relative to Sept 20 funeral mass; identify Erika's referenced social media exchange.

claims.label: Lisa Knows Accuses Candace of Releasing Restricted Footage
claims.claim: An X account called Lisa Knows posted that Candace released footage the judge ordered not be shown to the public, asserted Candace had "docketed a witness" for the prosecution, and called for obstruction charges against Candace.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify original tweet; cross-reference court orders on broadcasting exhibits.

claims.label: Community Note Clarifies Broadcasting Limits and Obstruction Standard
claims.claim: A Community Note applied to the obstruction-accusation tweets clarified that court broadcasting limits apply to courtroom media (not third-party commentators) and that legal obstruction of justice requires corrupt intent to impede proceedings.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify original tweet with Community Note attached; consult legal authority on obstruction statute elements (18 U.S.C. § 1503 et seq.).

claims.label: Tim Pool Characterizes Lozi Footage as Counter to Exploding Mic Claims
claims.claim: Tim Pool tweeted in response to Alex Jones that the Losee rooftop footage "serves as a counter to the exploding Mike claims."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify original tweet content and timing.

claims.label: Podcast Describes Another Angle Showing Weapon Handling
claims.claim: On a show the host calls the "Beavis and Butt-Head show," a speaker identified as Andrew says people inside the courtroom told him another angle shows the shooter roll over the railing and assemble the weapon, partly obscured by the railing; a second speaker adds that he appears to pull the rifle from his pant leg, there is a brief blind spot, and the visible Lozi footage then shows him running and taking a prone position.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the actual podcast; obtain the full episode; verify whether any second rooftop footage was formally entered as evidence.

claims.label: Media Siege Shares Baby Photo to Argue Untrained Reflex
claims.claim: The host says an account she calls "Paramount Not So Tactical," a regular on Media Siege in her telling, shared a photo of a baby learning to crawl, which she says was offered as proof that the rooftop figure was untrained rather than tactical.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original tweet; identify the posting account; confirm image attribution.

claims.label: X User Calls for Candace's Arrest on Obstruction Charges
claims.claim: An X user posted that if Candace was not charged with "obstruction of jury tampering" for releasing the rooftop footage, she is part of the two-tiered justice system, and said people need to go to jail.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify original tweet content; note possible transcription artifacts in quote.

claims.label: Viewer Email Credits Candace's Series With Helping Marriage
claims.claim: A viewer emailed Candace crediting her Becoming Brigitte series with helping their marriage recover from the husband's emotional affair, leading to renewed conversations and reconnection with the viewer's sister.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify by contacting the viewer with consent; tangential to the Kirk investigation but artifact-anchored.

claims.label: Clip Shows Erika Answering Yes That Tyler Robinson Murdered Her Husband
claims.claim: The clip the host plays shows Erika Kirk answering "Yes, I do" when asked whether she believes Tyler Robinson murdered her husband.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original interview in which Erika Kirk was asked this question and confirm date and outlet.
claims.transcript_snippet: Do you believe that Tyler Robinson murdered your husband? >> Yes, I do.

claims.label: Host Says No Evidence Indicated Tyler Robinson Guilt After Sitting With Erika
claims.claim: The host says that after she sat down with Erika Kirk there was no evidence which indicated that Tyler Robinson murdered Charlie, and that she still does not understand Erika's confidence at the preliminary hearing stage.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's private interview with Erika to the evidence presented at the preliminary hearing.
claims.transcript_snippet: After I sat down with her, there was no evidence which indicated that.

claims.label: Host Says Exclusive Rooftop Video Released the Day Before Raised Questions
claims.claim: The host says her exclusive video released the previous day has the internet asking a lot of questions about what can or cannot be seen on the Losee rooftop.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the released video and its provenance; compare with the preliminary hearing exhibits.
claims.transcript_snippet: Internet, I can say definitively, especially after the exclusive video that we released yesterday, has a lot of questions.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler's Defense Filed Memorandum Highlighting Autopsy Injuries
claims.claim: The host says that Tyler Robinson's defense filed a memorandum highlighting injuries to Charlie Kirk found at autopsy, including that his heart and lungs hemorrhaged after a bullet hit his neck (she corrects the filer later in the episode).
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the filed memorandum from the court docket and identify which party filed it and when.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm sorry, Tyler's defense filed the memorandum. They highlighted some injuries that Charlie had in his autopsy.

claims.label: Host Says Influencers Brought to Court Are Lying About What They Saw
claims.claim: The host says influencers were brought to the courtroom and are going out and lying about what they saw inside it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which influencers attended the preliminary hearing and who invited them; compare their public accounts with the exhibits.
claims.transcript_snippet: but they're bringing literal influencers to court and lying.

claims.label: Host Alleges Influencers Were Instructed to Perform Dramatic Reactions
claims.claim: The host alleges that influencers were brought into the courtroom and then instructed to put on over-the-top dramatic performances pretending to have encountered a blitzkrieg of evidence, which she says has since been debunked.
claims.investigative_direction: Find who coordinated influencer attendance at the hearing and any instructions given to them.
claims.transcript_snippet: bringing influencers into a courtroom and then instructing those influencers to put on these bizarre over-the-top dramatic performances

claims.label: Host Says Her Video Shows the Rooftop Person Was a Decoy Who Never Fired
claims.claim: The host says her video argued the person on the Lozi roof was a decoy who never fired a shot, and that Tim Pool misread the video as a counter to the exploding mic claims.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the rooftop footage frame by frame with the position, angle and timing of the fatal shot.
claims.transcript_snippet: Effectively, we were saying this person was a decoy and never fired a shot.

claims.label: Host Relays Viewer Point That Gravel Would Have Kicked Up From a .30-06
claims.claim: The host says viewers told her that gravel would have visibly kicked up if the rooftop person had fired a .30-06.
claims.investigative_direction: Have a ballistics expert assess whether muzzle blast would disturb roof gravel at that position and distance.
claims.transcript_snippet: You would have seen the gravel kick up if he had shot a.30-06.

claims.label: Host Says Even Her Source's Recording Does Not Show a Gun
claims.claim: The host says there is no evidence that any gun was on the rooftop and that even her source who recorded the video neither says nor shows a gun.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview the person who recorded the rooftop video and review the raw file for any weapon.
claims.transcript_snippet: Even our source, the person who recorded, in that recording, he doesn't say or show a gun.

claims.label: Blake Neff Says the Defense Demanded the Footage Be Kept From the Public
claims.claim: The host reads Blake Neff's post saying it is the defense that demanded the Lozi footage be kept from the public on the grounds that it would prejudice Tyler Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the docket for the defense motion seeking to limit public release of the rooftop exhibit.
claims.transcript_snippet: it is the defense that demanded that it be kept from the public on the grounds that it would prejudice Tyler.

claims.label: Host Says Neff's Other-Angle Claim Is New to Her
claims.claim: The host says she has never heard anyone claim before that another video angle shows the rooftop person pulling a rifle from his pants and that Neff is making that claim.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the prosecution and court whether a second rooftop angle exists in the exhibit list.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've never heard anybody make the claim that there's another angle of a video where we can see him pull the rifle out of his pants.

claims.label: Neff Says the Rooftop Person Does Not Look Like Anyone at That Distance
claims.claim: The host reads Neff's post saying the individual on the roof does not look like Tyler Robinson because they literally do not look like anyone at that distance.
claims.investigative_direction: Measure resolvable detail in the rooftop clip at the camera-to-subject distance.
claims.transcript_snippet: The individual does not look like Tyler Robinson because they literally don't look like anyone at that distance.

claims.label: Neff Says Campus Footage Shows a Close-Up of a Person His Parents Identified
claims.claim: The host reads Neff's post saying other campus footage supports Tyler being there and includes close-up footage of a person who looks enough like Tyler that his own parents identified him.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the campus footage exhibits and any statement from Tyler Robinson's parents about identification.
claims.transcript_snippet: We have close-up footage of the person who looks enough like Tyler that his own parents identified him as such.

claims.label: Host Says There Is Zero Proof Tyler's Parents Identified Him in Footage
claims.claim: The host says there is zero proof that Tyler Robinson's parents identified him in the footage and that this is just Neff narrating.
claims.investigative_direction: Check charging documents and hearing testimony for any parental identification from footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's zero proof his parents said that.

claims.label: Host Says Plates and Car in the Campus Footage Were Blurry
claims.claim: The host says that the campus footage Neff cites as matching Tyler's car arriving had blurry plates and a blurry car, so Neff is making assumptions.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the car-arrival footage exhibit and any plate or vehicle-match analysis.
claims.transcript_snippet: the footage that also captured a match of Tyler's car arriving on campus, those plates were blurry. The car was blurry.

claims.label: Neff Says the Medical Examiner Report Confirms a Bullet Came From That Direction
claims.claim: The host reads Neff's post saying a gun was fired from the rooftop spot because a bullet coming from that direction killed Charlie, as confirmed in the medical examiner's report.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the autopsy's wound trajectory description with the rooftop and Charlie's seat positions.
claims.transcript_snippet: we know a gun was fired from the spot because a bullet coming from that direction was what killed Charlie, as confirmed in the medical examiner's report.

claims.label: Neff Says Recoil From a Prone Position Can Easily Be Minimal
claims.claim: The host reads Neff's post saying recoil from a prone firing position can easily be minimal.
claims.investigative_direction: Consult a firearms expert on visible recoil of a rifle fired prone from a rooftop.
claims.transcript_snippet: Recoil from a prone firing position can easily be minimal

claims.label: Show Speaker Says Courtroom Contacts Describe a Different Angle Not in the Clip
claims.claim: In the clip the host labels the Beavis and Butt-Head show, a speaker says he checked with people inside the courtroom, who told him the clip shown does not include a different angle in which the person rolls over the railing and assembles the weapon.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the show and speakers, and obtain the court exhibit list to see whether a second angle was admitted.
claims.transcript_snippet: I did check with people inside the courtroom that day, and they're um they're saying that this clip that was shown

claims.label: Host Says Courtroom Influencers Earlier Claimed the Footage Was 4K and Tyler
claims.claim: The host says the same courtroom influencers whom the show platformed earlier said the footage was in 4K and that the person was Tyler Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the influencers' original posts describing the footage as 4K and identifying Tyler.
claims.transcript_snippet: we platformed them as they said that it was in 4K and it was Tyler Robinson

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Was Initially Very Open About Charlie's Body
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point's extreme sensitivity about Charlie's body is new, because TPUSA was initially very open about it.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect early TPUSA and family statements and posts about Charlie's body, transport and viewing.
claims.transcript_snippet: they were initially very open about Charlie's body.

claims.label: Host Says Elizabeth McCoy Allegedly Recorded Erika at the Open Casket in Utah
claims.claim: The host says she has been told it was allegedly Elizabeth McCoy, not Stacy Sheridan as she previously said, who recorded Erika in Charlie's open casket in Utah.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Elizabeth McCoy or Erika's team who filmed the casket video, and check the metadata of the posted clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've actually been told that it was allegedly Elizabeth McCoy that was recording Erika in Charlie's open casket in Utah.

claims.label: Host Dates the Utah Casket Recording to Sept 11 Midday
claims.claim: The host says the recording of Erika at Charlie's open casket was made in Utah on September 11 around midday.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the casket video's capture time and location against the Sept 10 to 12 travel records.
claims.transcript_snippet: in Charlie's open casket in Utah. That's September 11th, midday-ish.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Posted the Utah Casket Footage the Day After It Was Captured
claims.claim: The host says that on September 12 Erika moved to post the footage Elizabeth captured the day before in Utah, with Charlie by then back in Phoenix at Hansen, so viewers may wrongly think it was taken in Phoenix.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the post date with the capture date and where the casket was on each day.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika moves to post the footage that Elizabeth actually captured the day before in Utah.

claims.label: Host Says the Catholic Funeral Mass Was Held Sept 20 at a Church Charlie Attended
claims.claim: The host says that on September 20 at around 11:00 a.m. Charlie was no longer at Hansen and had a Catholic funeral mass at a Catholic church he regularly attended.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the date, church and officiant of the funeral mass from parish and TPUSA announcements.
claims.transcript_snippet: He is now having a Catholic funeral mass that is held at a Catholic church that Charlie regularly attends.

claims.label: Host Says the Funeral Mass Was Not Open to the Public but Not Hidden
claims.claim: The host says the Catholic mass was not open to the public but was not hidden from it, since it occurred alongside the parish's regular mass and parishioners saw the hearse.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain parish schedule and accounts from parishioners who saw the hearse.
claims.transcript_snippet: obviously was not open to the public, but it was not hidden from the public

claims.label: Host Says a Mockingbird Campaign Attacked Her Over the Conversion Rumblings
claims.claim: The host says an entire mockingbird campaign was launched to attack her after she publicly asserted there were rumblings that Charlie was close to converting to Catholicism.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the host's original statement on Charlie's conversion and the coordinated responses that followed.
claims.transcript_snippet: there was an entire mockingbird campaign which was launched to attack me after I publicly um asserted that there were rumblings that Charlie was close to converting

claims.label: Host Says She and Charlie Discussed Him Taking the Next Step Toward Catholicism
claims.claim: The host says the question of Charlie converting was a conversation that happened even between her and Charlie, with her telling him to take the next step.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for messages or witnesses to the host's conversations with Charlie about Catholicism.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was a conversation that was happening even between me and Charlie.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Made Shutting Down the Conversion Idea a High Priority
claims.claim: The host says that in the immediate aftermath of Charlie's assassination it was a high priority for Turning Point to come out and shut down the idea that he was close to converting.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile TPUSA's early statements on Charlie's faith and their timing.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was something that was a high priority in the immediate aftermath of Charlie's assassination for Turning Point to come out and to clarify.

claims.label: Kolvet Says Charlie Really Loved Catholic Mass and Its Ritual
claims.claim: In the Alex Clark show clip, Andrew Kolvet answers that Charlie was not becoming Catholic but really loved Catholic mass and its ritual.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Alex Clark interview.
claims.transcript_snippet: No. But he really loved Catholic mass. He loved the ritual of it.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Texted Erika Throughout the Pre-Recorded Interview for Approval
claims.claim: The host says she is told the Kolvet interview was pre-recorded and that Andrew was texting with Erika throughout, so the public messaging had Erika's stamp of approval.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unedited recording and Kolvet's and Erika's messages during the taping.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew was texting with Erika throughout this recording to ensure that he was okay with what she was what he was saying and what he was sharing.

claims.label: Host Says the Interview Was Pre-Recorded Before the Funeral Mass, a Day Earlier
claims.claim: The host says the Kolvet denial was a pre-record made before Charlie's Catholic funeral mass, a day before the family moved to hold that mass.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish the recording date of the Alex Clark episode against the Sept 20 funeral mass.
claims.transcript_snippet: it was a pre-record which took place before Charlie's Catholic funeral mass. A day later, after saying this, you move to have a Catholic funeral mass.

claims.label: Host Says the Mock Burial Tip Has Checked Out in a Major Way
claims.claim: The host says she received a tip about the Hansen move and that the tip has checked out in a major way.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify what in the tip has been independently verified and by whom.
claims.transcript_snippet: We received a tip. And this tip has checked out in a major way.

claims.label: Host Says Hansen Refused to Take Part in a Mock Burial
claims.claim: The host says a person alleged, with proof she deems credible, that Charlie was brought to Hansen and then moved because Hansen refused to take part in a mock burial.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Hansen Mortuary whether it was asked to host or arrange a mock burial; obtain the text messages the host says she read.
claims.transcript_snippet: the person alleged with proof that I deem to be credible, um that the reason that Charlie was brought to Hansen and was ultimately moved was because the company refused to take part in a

claims.label: Host Says She Read Text Messages Supporting the Mock Burial Account
claims.claim: The host says she finds the information credible because she read text messages sent to this effect by people who would have knowledge of it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain or have an independent party review the text messages the host describes.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's because I read through text messages uh that were sent to this effect from the people that would have knowledge of this.

claims.label: Host Says Hansen Declined and TPUSA Shopped Around
claims.claim: The host says she is told Hansen declined to participate in a mock burial, so Turning Point USA had to shop around.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which funeral homes or churches TPUSA contacted and what was requested.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, I am told that Hansen declined to participate in a mock burial. So, Turning Point USA then had to shop around.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Landed on the Catholic Church Because of Erika's Ties to the Priest
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA landed upon the Catholic Church because of Erika's very strong ties to the priest.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the priest and the arrangements made between the family and the parish.
claims.transcript_snippet: they landed upon the Catholic Church because of Erika's very strong ties to the priest.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Brought the Priest to Utah Instead of Flying Family Members
claims.claim: The host says that after learning her husband was shot, Erika coordinated to bring the priest to Utah rather than flying out her family members.
claims.investigative_direction: Check flight and travel records for the priest and for Erika's family members on Sept 10 to 11.
claims.transcript_snippet: rather than flying her family members out there, she coordinated to bring the priest.

claims.label: Host Says the Priest Traveled With Erika to Ole Miss on Oct 29
claims.claim: The host says the priest traveled with Erika to the Turning Point event featuring the vice president at Ole Miss on October 29.
claims.investigative_direction: Review event footage and credential lists for the priest at Ole Miss.
